lineage.transform: Projection of EstateAdmissibilityReport documents (sourceos-spec schemas/EstateAdmissibilityReport.json, SP-FPRINT-STACK-001 section 4) into a catalog row per estate, with a derived A-F trust grade. The grade is RECOMPUTED from the layer states and n_eff by tools/grade_classification_admissibility.py — it is never carried in the source document, so a report cannot assert a grade its own measurements do not support.

checks: every record carries all six fingerprint layers (an omitted layer is indistinguishable from an admissible one)
every inadmissible layer carries a named reason from the closed set
grade recomputed from layers + n_eff, never asserted
pos_available false whenever n_eff is below floor
degraded layers cannot count toward an A grade
